title: Warsaw · Masurian Lakes Long Ride
slogan: Lake country, long distance and a calmer Poland.
story: Lake country, long distance and a calmer Poland. Out of Pułtusk and back again: 491 km, roughly 8 h 28 in the saddle. The stops in between: Mikołajki lakes, Giżycko and Mrągowo roads.

sections.advice: Warsaw start → Pułtusk river town is the reward section in Warsaw. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.
sections.photoQuery: Warsaw start Pułtusk river town Warsaw

sections.advice: Use Mikołajki lakes → Giżycko food as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

This Giżycko food → Mrągowo roads stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.title: Mazury Lakes Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 45 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
